status: Data and wire evidence recovered; C implementation newly reconstructed

projects.title: A roof over every head
projects.pitch: Maya: A dry ledger is a useful ledger. A dry adventurer is a pleasant surprise. Bring lumber and cloth; we will repair the roof and door.

projects.title: A table with room for one more
projects.pitch: Yuufa: We have beds. Now we need somewhere people can sit without being asked why they are here.

projects.title: Dagna's second chance
projects.pitch: Dagna: This bench makes hinges, not restraints. You may remind me of that whenever necessary.

projects.title: Copies nobody can burn
projects.pitch: Nera: One copy is a secret. Several copies, in several hands, are a record.

projects.title: A door held wider
projects.pitch: Brann: The next room is empty. The landlord calls it storage. I think we can improve that description.

projects.title: The extremely important recreation annex
projects.pitch: Maya: Rest is productive. I have written it in the accounts, so it must be true. Help Pip wire the cabinets.

projects.title: Poring Pong
projects.pitch: Pip: The Poring volunteered to be a ball. The paddle remains unconvinced. Build our first cabinet.

projects.title: Peco Patrol
projects.pitch: Corin: This one shoots at painted monsters. I recommend it over several of my previous employers.

projects.title: Herb Trail
projects.pitch: Yuufa: You eat herbs, get longer, and must not bite yourself. I am assured this is medicinal research.

projects.title: Pupa Breaker
projects.pitch: Dagna: An excellent demonstration of applied force. Please use the cabinet, not the guild's actual walls.

projects.title: Kafra's Lost Parcels
projects.pitch: Nera: Sixteen parcels. Fifteen spaces. A familiar workplace situation, regrettably.

projects.title: Moonlight Munch
projects.pitch: Miri: The ghosts agreed to chase a Poring for an afternoon. Nobody is bound here; the dots are biscuits.
